subgoal.rationale: Current separation is measured at 100.0 m with zero relative speed. To progress along the closing corridor while preserving safe braking margins, a port-directed waypoint is set at 50.0 m, approximately half of the current separation along the X axis. The target velocity is commanded at -0.1 m/s along X with zero lateral and vertical rates, strictly respecting the secondary envelope speed ceiling of 0.1 m/s.
alternatives: Station-keeping at the current 100 m standoff was rejected because closing phase objectives require continuing the approach toward the docking port.
Adopting the short RL lookahead position of [99.2, -0.1, -0.04] m directly was rejected because braking at an immediate point only 0.8 m ahead would stall closing progress.
Commanding higher velocities up to the primary envelope limit was rejected to strictly respect the conservative secondary limit of 0.1 m/s and ensure ample braking margins.
subgoal.rl_assessment: The learned PPO advisor proposes a short 4-second lookahead position at 99.2 m and an approach speed of roughly 0.4 m/s. We reject the short lookahead position to prevent premature braking, establishing instead a waypoint at half separation (50.0 m). We limit the advisory closing speed from 0.4 m/s down to 0.1 m/s so that the trajectory complies with the secondary envelope motion limits.

result.minimum_speed_rule: Transit preference; braking and capture may use zero speed.
